notes.title: Update 0.12.5
notes.notes:
· The player now has to pass through the underground area to get to the main central area. The underground area has been extended and connects with the large circular building. This includes a new large interior space that the player passes through.
· Global game events can now occur sooner and now depend on player progress.
· Enemy robots now inflict much more damage, encouraging the player to be more tactical. They can no longer just run past groups of them and hope for the best. 

Old saves can still be loaded for this build, but it is strongly advised to start new games as some of the changes will affect the overall gameplay.

notes.title: Update 0.12.0.5
notes.notes:
· Various minor graphics and lighting tweaks. Increased the shadow quality for the high end graphics setting, which now has a much further draw distance and fewer artefacts.
· Some minor improvements and fixes to surrounding apartment buildings in the start area.

notes.title: Update 0.12.0
notes.notes:
· Game now starts in an entirely new area on a hillside facing the settlement, requiring you to take the flying shuttle transport to reach the main settlement area.
· The apartment building where the game begins, has been totally rebuilt. It is much larger and more detailed, and now has several rooms.

It was decided to allow old saves to still be loadable for this build, but it is strongly advised to start new games, especially for games that were saved in the original game start area, which will very likely have some issues with stability.

notes.title: Update 0.11.0
notes.notes:
• A new weapon, a portable defensive sentry drone type, has been added. These can been stored and retrieved using the same controls as the grenades. You can toggle selection between these two storable types by pressing the retrieve button for over half a second. The highlighted icon on the HUD will indicate which storable type the button will retrieve when pressed. 
• Once placed in the world, they will hover and settle to a height of around 1m above the ground, at which point you can activate them by pressing the button on their top. They have eight extending guns that automatically fire lasers at any approaching robots that come into their range. 
• They have limited energy and will perform a controlled drop to the floor when low on power. They can be picked up and recharged just like your raygun at the charging stations. A bar on their top displays current battery level


This build should be compatible with saves from the previous 0.9.0, 0.10.0 and 0.10.1 versions.
Saves from builds 0.8.0 and earlier will still use the old game event timings, so for the best experience it is advised to start a new game in that case.

notes.title: Update 0.10.1
notes.notes:
• Grabbing hold of grenades, raygun upgrades and passes is now much easier. They get highlighted when in pickup range and will snap to your hand when you press trigger. If there is more than one pickup in range the closest is highlighted to make it clearer which one you'll be grabbing.
• More updates to central circular building. An effect has been added to the rotating sphere on the roof level. Also some fixes to the building's exterior lighting.
• Fix for music switching which was not working correctly with humanoid robots.

This build should be compatible with saves from the previous 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 versions.
Saves from builds 0.8.0 and earlier will still use the old game event timings, so for the best experience it is advised to start a new game in that case.

notes.title: Update 0.10.0
notes.notes:
• The large circular building in the central district has now been totally remodelled with higher detail and is now enterable. It's much larger and now includes a large atrium area with 6 accessible floors using internal spiral walkways and lifts. 
• A skybridge connects the neighbouring Siphonovium building's rooftop and its shuttle station to this new building's domed glass roof level.
• More robots have been added to the central district.


This build should be compatible with saves from the previous 0.9.0 version.
Saves made using builds 0.8.0 and earlier will still use the old game event timings, so for the best experience it is advised to start a new game for that case.

notes.title: Update 0.9.0
notes.notes:
• Humanoid robot behaviour is now much more varied during the early stages of the game. They can now switch between walking, sitting and standing states. When approached in the standing state, they can choose to say something to you from a set of short phrases that change as the game progresses. They might also say location specific phrases that may be helpful in progressing in the game.
• Raygun upgrades and other pickups scattered around the map, now display a highlighted effect and play a sound as you approach them, making them much easier to locate. 
• Some fixes to the robot pacing state just prior to coming in to attack you. Also the rate at which robots get more aggressive has been decreased. 
• Improvements to raygun button selection,  and selection using the shuttle ticket machine touch screens.
• The timings for key game events have been spread out, giving the player a lot more time to explore and get more familiar with the settlement's surroundings, and to collect items for better defence in the later stages of the game.
• A shuttle route map has been added to all the stations. 


This build should be compatible with saves from older versions, although older saves will still have the old game event timings, so for the best experience it is advised to start a new game.

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.notes:
• The surrounding environment has been updated with a new much more expansive terrain. 
• A new enterable building has been added on one of the surrounding mountains which is reachable by taking a shuttle from the [i]Tria Sanctuary[/i] station (located on upper levels of the triple-towered building). This building will become an access point to a new area in the mountains, coming in a future update.
• Updated to use Unreal Engine version 4.27.2

This build should be compatible with your current saves.

Future updates should be coming at roughly 2 month intervals, with version 0.9.0 sometime during the first week of August.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
After another pause in development, I am happy to announce that development on Settlement Zero has now fully resumed! 

Several improvements and additions are planned over the coming months. The first new update (0.8.0),  will be coming in late May. More details about dates and what to expect for the following updates will be given at that time. 

The current aim is for a final 1.0 release in December 2022, but there are some further improvements, potential characters and new areas that are still to be decided upon, so it is possible that this date may move slightly to accommodate these additions.

notes.title: Update 0.7.1.3
notes.notes:
• Unreal Engine updated to version 4.26.1
• Central square area ground lightmap fixes
• Fix for a visibility related bug in the starship's interior

notes.title: Update 0.7.1.2
notes.notes:
• Added sight perception to the humanoid robots which now only approach and attack once they've spotted you. They also now have a more gradual increase in aggressiveness as the game progresses.
• Spread out times for some high level events.
• Optimizations to Starship

notes.title: Update 0.7.1
notes.notes:
• You now have a watch-like communications device with a projected holographic screen on your right hand. It will be receiving messages from friends that managed to escape on the starship. New messages are displayed automatically when you move the device into your view. You can re-display older messages by reactivating the display. This is done by touching the lower left button ( below the projector lens) of the device which toggles the projected display on and off. Once on, you can use the lower right button to step back through and display past messages. This will be developed further in future updates with more messages giving you some clues as to what is happening.

This update wont invalidate save data and should be compatible with your current saves.

notes.title: Update 0.7.0
notes.notes:
• A new large interior area added which contains the games final finish with you escaping the settlement. 
	• Laser cannons on towers now defend the spaceport. These can be disabled with 4 charged up plasma ball shots to their turrets.
	• An enterable control tower building surrounded by a force field wall added next to the launch pad in the spaceport area.
	• A first pass music system has been added which checks your current danger level and switches the music accordingly.
	• You can now gain temporary invulnerability from laser or plasma fire, from an energy field located somewhere in the settlement. The duration the protection is active is relative to your shield amount at the time of exposure to the energy field.
	• Particle effect performance optimizations.

It was decided not to invalidate saves, even though this is a major update. This build should be compatible with your current saves.

notes.title: Update v0.6.3
notes.notes:
• Launch pad area by the spaceport has been updated.
• The current end area where the game currently finishes has also had an update, giving you a glimpse of a final new area
• Plasma ball particle effects have been improved using the Niagara visual effects system.
• Detail has been added to Telluris Tower.
• Engine update (to 4.25.4)

This update wont invalidate save data and should be compatible with your current saves.

notes.title: Update v0.6.2
notes.notes:
* The second ‘blue’ shuttle line is now operational and takes you to a new terrace area at the top of the triple towers located by the spaceport. Several more shuttle passes have been placed at various locations around the settlement.
* The game start has been updated. Evacuation shuttles buses now fly from various locations to the spaceport just before the Starship takes-off.  These can be useful later for cover in the spaceport area.

This update wont invalidate save data and should be compatible with your current saves

notes.title: Update v0.6.1
notes.notes:
* A creature type has been added that slowly moves around in the air and contains a special shield-giving plasma in its body visible through its transparent skin. The plasma is increasingly excited when you fire your laser at the creatures, and eventually released in an explosion. If in range, you will receive a shield boost, the amount depending on your distance to the creature when the plasma is released. 
* The plasma explosion will also give damage to anything in range, including you as it will bypass your shield and directly hit your health. The shield will protect you against all damage apart from the creature plasma explosion. Note that you also now lose health at a much faster rate when receiving damage with zero shield.

This update wont invalidate save data and should be compatible with your current saves.

notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
- Progress Save feature has been added. You can now save your current game progress in one of 5 save slots accessible though both the main and in-game menus. 

- Pickup-able shuttle transport passes can now be found lying around at a few spread out places on the map. By picking them up and pressing the STORE button on the left controller (previously only used for storing grenades) , you collect the Shuttle Credits on the pass. These come in 2,4, and 10 Shuttle Credits. These will become more relevant in future updates when the Blue Shuttle line becomes active with its higher journey costs.

- The Humanoid robots running speed has been increased so they can now catch and hit you more easily. Also their hits now inflict slightly more damage.


Even though every effort will be made to prevent having to invalidate save data in future updates, some future work with major gameplay changes will inevitably require save data to be cleared. This will be limited only to the larger updates (0.7.0, 0.8.0 etc...) so best not to get too attached to your saves until the Full Release... Whether or not an update will invalidate saves will be stated in every future update post. Will look into making older builds still available through the Beta settings tab so that people that wish to keep playing older builds can continue doing that.

notes.title: Update v0.5.0
notes.notes:
* A new enterable building has been added in the park giving you the option of cover when in that area. It will also serve as the first station of a new ‘blue’ flying shuttle line. This station will stay ‘out of service’ until the other locations the line serves are built.
* Engine update (to 4.25.3)
* Variations to robot AI attack. Some robots will now pause and pace around you before coming in to attack. Aggressiveness also will vary depending on the amount of damage the robot has received. It will also increase as the game progresses. This is still a work in progress and will be continually improved in future updates.

notes.title: Update v0.4.2
notes.notes:
* You can now use your raygun to momentarily knock back humanoid robots. Doesn’t apply any damage to the robots, but does mean you can now fend them off if you find yourself out of ammo or surrounded by them. Also several minor improvements to the robots including some audio updates.
* Fixed an issue where the player’s collision was not being updating properly when moving around VR play area. Player is now blocked from moving into walls if they move around the VR space without using the controller. This is currently handed by repositioning the world. A comfort option is being considered so if anybody feels they would benefit from such an option so this can be prioritised, it would be good to get some feedback.
* Performance optimisations for recently added Transport System.

notes.title: Update v0.4.1
notes.notes:
* A public transport system has been added which allows you to quickly travel between 4 locations on the map using flying shuttle buses. Other locations will be added in future updates.
* Destinations can be selected using ticket machines located by the departure gates at these location. You may either touch using your left hand or use your raygun’s laser for selection. Once the destination is highlighted, confirming selection will subtract the listed cost from your shuttle credits which are now displayed on your HUD and ticket machine screen.
* If there is no shuttle at the location you wish to travel from, you can call a shuttle and one will arrive from a neighbouring location.
* If you do not board the shuttle within 2 minutes of purchasing, the shuttle will leave without you.
* A future update will add shuttle credit passes scattered around the environment which you can pickup.

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
* Added physical animation to humanoid robots. Laser hits on them now result in more varied and localised reactions. 
* New updated higher detail flying car type vehicles placed around the environment. Currently only used as scenery. 
* Engine update (to 4.24.3) which should give noticeable performance improvements
* Lighting and sky atmosphere changes
* Fixes to a couple of holes in the environment that were allowing you to fall outside of the world

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
After a pause in development, I am pleased to announce that work on Settlement Zero has now resumed, with an update scheduled for the end of April. This will be followed by more regular updates over the coming months, and if all goes to plan, a final release later in the summer. 

Hope to post more details on these future updates soon.

notes.title: Update v0.3.2
notes.notes:
* Updated various buildings and models in the environment and fixed some issues with lightmaps. Also added some new surrounding buildings behind the main tower. 
* You now have access to a second building rooftop. This gives you an alternative quicker route for getting back to ground level from the rooftop made accessible in the previous update.

notes.title: Update v0.3.1
notes.notes: * Added several new passages accessible from the central square’s lower level. One of these gives access to the rooftop of one of the buildings giving you a very different vantage point and good location option for engaging in combat with the enemy drones and spacecraft.

notes.title: Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
* A new Drone robot type had been added. Capable of both flying at altitude, and hovering close to ground level. More resilient than the other 3 robot types. It takes accumulative damage from all your weapons, unlike the patrolling spacecraft above that only take damage from charged up balls of plasma. It fires a series of high energy plasma pulses from 2 guns mounted on its wings so can inflict a considerable amount of damage. They are capable of getting to all areas on the surface of the settlement, so you need to think carefully about your location when they come for you.
* Changes to the Starship’s return route so that it now flies directly over the settlement on its return journey.
* Tweaks to game difficulty. An increase in your total health to compensate for the added challenge of surviving the Drones.
* The underground area accessible from the surface lifts has been extended.

notes.title: Update v0.2.2
notes.notes: * An underground area has been added consisting of a network of rooms and passages. This area can be accessed from lifts placed at several points on the surface.

notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.notes:
* A new non-humanoid robot type has been added! They are smaller and a bit slower than the humanoid robots, but can fire small balls of plasma that can give you a fair amount of damage at close range. These can been found at various locations throughout the settlement.

*A torch upgrade for your raygun is now available as a pickup. Use same process to apply the upgrade as with the battery and crystal module upgrades, just pickup with your left hand and move it to your raygun. There is a button on the side for turning it on and off. It uses your raygun's energy so wont work when energy runs out. A dimly lit underground area is planned for a future update, so it will become much useful once that's completed.

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
* New raygun pulse weapon upgrade allowing your raygun to also fire balls of plasma. This requires a new resource in the form of Laser Crystal Modules. These wear with use and need regular replacement.
* Two modes of operation are available. Either firing as a continuous stream, or a single chargeable plasma ball of up to 4x strength, speed and cost. Each plasma ball fired uses up both energy and laser crystal resources.
* The 2 buttons on your raygun are now operational and allow you to selection either of these pulse weapon modes. A small screen with a magenta coloured bar on the side of the raygun displays the current state of the crystal module, and will also indicate when it needs replacing.
* Laser Crystal Module upgrades can be applied to your raygun by picking them up and moving them to your raygun. Replacement Raygun Crystal Modules can be found lying around the environment. 
* Patrolling spacecraft can now be permanently disabled by hitting them with 3 plasma balls with at least a 50% charge-up. A plasma ball with less than 50% charge-up will just cause an immediate temporary retreat, so giving no accumulative damage  (the same as if being hit by the standard laser, but immediate)

notes.title: Update v0.1.3
notes.notes:
* Impact Grenades Added. These can be found scattered around the environment. Store/Retrieve grenades using the Left controller's Menu Button ( Y Button on the Rift). 
* HUD has been updated to display the current number of grenades in your possession.

The grenades will explode immediately on impact with anything when thrown, but will not explode if shot with your laser. This means you can use your laser to ‘push’ grenades that are just out of your reach.

notes.title: Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
* Battery upgrades x2 and x4 now available as pickups for your raygun. There are several scattered around the environment. Upgrade is performed by picking up the battery with your left hand (using left trigger), and moving it to your raygun.  
* Robots now use Ragdoll Physics when shot down or knocked down by an abject, or thrown around by an explosion.
* Batteries can be used as small explosives. Your raygun’s laser will detonate them. Careful as they can also give you damage. They have a relatively small blast radius, but will detonate other batteries in a chain reaction if they are in blast range. Note that they don’t explode if thrown ( grenades will be added in a future update….)

notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.notes:
This is an intermediate update.

* Ability to pickup, drop and throw objects scattered around the environment.
* Robots reacting to being hit by laser fire or objects thrown at them.
* Ability to use of Raygun’s laser to push pickup-able objects. 

Your right hand closes when close to an item that can be pickup up. Press the Right Trigger Button when very close to pickup it up, and keep pressed to hold onto it. To throw an item, swing arm and release trigger ( remember to make sure your play space is totally clear from anything breakable! )

Another way to see what can be picked up is by firing at it. If it moves, then it can be picked up! 


KEYS CHANGE
JUMP has been moved to the Right Controller Trackpad Down for VIVE, and Button A on the Right Controller for the RIFT
